name: Access to Work Mental Health Support – Maximus
whoFor: People in work whose mental health affects their job; once only, from one provider (Able Futures or Maximus).
eligibility: Can only be used once; choose one provider
exclusions: People who have already had Access to Work Mental Health Support

selfReferral.note: Sign up using the online form

activities.name: Mental health support at work
activities.summary: Nine months of one-to-one support for anxiety, stress, burnout or depression at work.
